messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Page triggered: aws-eu-west-1 third-party control-plane errors (5xx) affecting Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Alerting SRE oncall.

sre-oncall: I’m on it. Seeing spike in 502/504 from `api-gateway.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com` and STS latency.

maya: Confirmed elevated latencies on /v1/generate routes, p50->p95 jumped from 120ms to 1.2s+. Some Dedicated pools report increased 5xx at the LB.

kevin: Checking cloud provider status: https://status.aws.amazon.com/ (linked). eu-west-1 reports problems with control plane services and STS region.

ops-bot: Observability alert: `auth-proxy` error-rate +200% in eu-west-1 since 09:12 UTC. Sample error: `upstream prematurely closed connection`

eng-prod: Can we route Hosted traffic away from eu-west-1 while this persists? Prefer minimal customer impact.

maya: Proposed live mitigations: 1) Enable routing fallback to eu-west-2 for non-data-residency customers, 2) Shift Dedicated pool scheduling off eu-west-1 nodes for new allocations, 3) Enable degraded-mode cache TTLs to reduce STS calls.

kevin: Rolling a quick routing policy change now: `rbac-route set --region-fallback eu-west-2 --priority 80 --scope hosted` (will monitor).

incident-bot: Deploy job started: `service-router:policy-update` (job #4782).

maya: Also bump Dedicated pool capacity in eu-west-2 and eu-central-1 for affected customers who pinned region: `dedicated-manager scale --pool eu-west-2 --delta +2`

support-lead: Notifying top affected customers (enterprise contacts) and PS team. Early impact: 3 customers reported API 502s, some timeouts in low-volume embeddings jobs.

kevin: Quick auth mitigation: enable short-circuit token-cache for `auth-proxy` to reduce STS calls: set `TOKEN_CACHE_TTL=30s` for eu-west-1 nodes.

maya: Adding temporary canary fallback for model variants (downgrade to smaller quantized variant to reduce inference latency). This reduces per-request resource contention.

eng-prod: Running smoke curl against region fallback: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.eu-west-2.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> 200 OK on canary.

ops-bot: Observability: request rate to eu-west-1 dropping ~40% after routing change, error-rate decreasing but still > normal.

maya: Pager duty: escalating to AWS support - opened case with logs and packet traces.

support-lead: Customer comms draft ready: short status update, mitigation steps, ETA unknown, will send after oncall review.

kevin: Temporary mitigation summary: fallback routing applied, token-cache reduced TTL, Dedicated pool allocations moved, model-variant canary enabled. Monitoring closely.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2. Oncall handoff ping to next SRE in 15m.

maya: Handing off to @kevin in 15 for monitoring and next steps. I’ll update runbook with actions taken.

kevin: Acknowledged. Leaving dashboards open, will coordinate with AWS and support. If error-rate <5% for 10min, consider status downgrade.

support-lead: Logged customer tickets and SLA risk assessment. No major data loss reported. Customer impact: elevated latency and transient 5xx for traffic routed through eu-west-1, some Dedicated jobs delayed.

eng-prod: Postmortem note: dependency on STS/control-plane single region caused ripple effect. Action items: multi-region auth failover documented, add automated reroute for >x% 5xx, improve cache fallback.

incident-bot: Update: 04:42 later - AWS reported mitigation work ongoing for eu-west-1. Continue monitoring. :white_check_mark:
